messages.message_content: Hello, I'm having trouble with my electricity bill. The amount seems too high.
I understand your concern about the high electricity bill. Let me check your account details.
My account number is 1234567890. This month's bill is double the usual amount.
I can see there was a meter reading error. I've corrected it and your bill has been adjusted. You'll receive an updated bill within 24 hours.
Thank you so much! That resolves my concern completely.
